Tightly related FHIR-32290 work later removed the remaining DeviceDefinition.physicalCharacteristics and corrected Device and DeviceDefinition property.value[x] minimum cardinality to 1.

Current source has no Device or DeviceDefinition element path named specialization, capability, or physicalCharacteristics; both property.value[x] elements are 1..1 and include Quantity, CodeableConcept, string, boolean, integer, Range, and Attachment. Later FHIR-36154/source history introduced standard-conformance modeling that current source represents as conformsTo, which is not a leftover of the removed FHIR-26424 elements.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the authoritative XML already satisfies the seed disposition after the original and follow-up application commits.
